occurrences.literalSourceText: IBRD's mission is to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by providing countries with loans, guarantees, advisory services, analytical support and other products.
occurrences.extractedText: IBRD's mission is to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by providing countries with loans, guarantees, advisory services, analytical support and other products.

occurrences.literalSourceText: IBRD and its affiliated institutions seek to help countries in reducing poverty and inequality, and achieve improvements in economic growth, job creation, governance, human capital, infrastructure, and debt transparency, among others. To meet its development goals, the World Bank Group (WBG 1) supports client countries' efforts to implement programs to improve growth and development outcomes with a vision to create a world free of poverty
